ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 60% low-intensity (black/dark gray) and 40% high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottling is concentrated on the distal ends of both lobes. The right lobe (viewer perspective) displays a larger contiguous white region at the tip, while the left lobe shows more fragmented white spotting. The central peduncle area and mid-fluke are predominantly low-intensity dark pixels punctuated by small white circular features.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 92 degrees and a depth of roughly 12% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and serrated boundary along the entire trailing edge; frequency of peaks increases toward the lobe tips, with pixel-amplitude variations of roughly 3-8 pixels from the median line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep from the distal tips toward the median notch; leading edge exhibits a broad convex curve tapering to sharp lateral points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular white ring-shaped features (approx. 5-15 pixels in diameter) concentrated on the right lobe and scattered across the central dark region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical and diagonal high-contrast white linear streaks detected in the lower-central dark region of the fluke.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive accumulation of circular barnacle attachment scars and multiple unaligned linear rake marks or scratches across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced pigmentation asymmetry with significantly more high-intensity white coverage and circular scarring on the right lobe compared to the left.
